description: This Java class defines a Fragment for demonstrating options for displaying Heads-Up Notifications in an Android app. It includes UI elements like a button and a checkbox, manages notification creation with options for heads-up display, and handles user interaction to trigger notifications.

classes.name: HeadsUpNotificationFragment
classes.description: A Fragment class that provides UI and logic for displaying configurable Heads-Up Notifications in an Android app.
